$comment: Starter as changes to Balanced (document 21, section 6.3). The build applies these operations to Balanced's source rows before wildcards expand, so gp-test is still the wildcard row here.
Every gate value is a preset value, not a decision: the change gate (D-03) is still open.
An upsert merges fields and cannot clear one. gp-prod-tier-3 carries a fail mode, which belongs only at enforce (V24), so it is retired and gp-prod-tier-3-flag replaces it.
Emergency rows already match Starter: record in test (gp-emergency-test) and flag in production with the emergency rule (gp-emergency-prod-tier-1 to gp-emergency-prod-tier-3).

Self-approval at tier 3 needs an accepted exception decision (document 28, Q10). An exception about an application goes to the architect and an exception about a change to the change board, as in Balanced.

values.label: No self-approval at tier 3 without an exception
